items.title: Add explicit non-DONE/non-Authority/non-production disclaimer strings to milestone_status and milestone_closeout rendered output
items.context: packages/main/src/core/milestone-status.ts renderMilestoneStatusReport (~L1146-1187), the missing-ledger report, and the closeout report currently emit only 'Mode: read-only'. Add an explicit disclaimer line stating milestone progress is not lifecycle DONE, not Authority, not production readiness. Closes findings M6 (report lines re: M1.f/M6). Update packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs to assert the disclaimer string is present.
items.userSees:
After running `lattice milestone_status --storyId=<id>` (or the milestone_closeout report), the operator sees a new explicit disclaimer line directly under the existing `Mode: read-only` header of every rendered report. Concretely:

- `milestone_status` (populated ledger) header block now reads:
  `Milestone Status - <id>`
  `Mode: read-only`
  `Disclaimer: Milestone progress is not lifecycle DONE, not Authority-signed, and not production readiness.`
  `Phase: <phase>` ...

- `milestone_status` with a MISSING ledger prints the same `Disclaimer:` line under `Mode: read-only` (progress cannot be inferred, and the report still must not imply DONE/Authority/production).

- `milestone_closeout` snapshot report header now reads:
  `Milestone Closeout - <id>`
  `Mode: read-only historical snapshot`
  `Disclaimer: This is a historical milestone snapshot, not lifecycle DONE, not Authority-signed, and not production readiness.`

- `milestone_closeout` missing-snapshot report prints the same `Disclaimer:` line under `Mode: read-only historical snapshot`.

The disclaimer text is a stable literal that mentions all three negatives (not lifecycle DONE, not Authority, not production readiness). No table columns, ordering, or other lines change; it is purely an added advisory line, consistent with the read-only/no-write posture of these commands.

This is NOT a lifecycle DONE, NOT an Authority verdict, and NOT a production-readiness gate.' and matches /observability only.*NOT a lifecycle DONE.*NOT an Authority verdict.*NOT a production-readiness gate/s. Delivered behavior emits the Scope-prefixed disclaimer, NOT a 'Disclaimer:' line.

items.title: Add 'Authority' to the milestone_status command-policy reason string to match milestone_closeout
items.context: packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts: the milestone_status reason (~L237) omits Authority while milestone_closeout (~L238) includes it. Add the Authority-silence fix so both read-only commands disclaim Authority uniformly. Closes findings M6 Authority-silence note.
items.userSees: After the fix, an operator inspecting the command-policy reason for milestone_status (via `lattice help milestone_status`, `getCommandPolicy('milestone_status').reason`, or any surface that renders the policy reason) sees the disclaimer end with an explicit Authority disclaimer matching milestone_closeout. Concretely the milestone_status reason tail changes from "…advances no phase, and never claims automatic DONE or production readiness." to "…advances no phase, and never claims automatic DONE, production, or remote Authority readiness." Both read-only milestone commands (milestone_status and milestone_closeout) now literally contain the word "Authority" in their reason string, so a grep for the token no longer shows a gap. No behavior, phase-gating, ownershipClass, destructiveRisk, or allowedPhases changes — only the human-readable reason string gains the uniform Authority-silence disclaimer, closing the M6 Authority-silence note.

happy.desc: Build packages/main (npm --prefix packages/main run build) then run: node -e "const {getCommandPolicy}=require('./packages/main/dist/core/command-policy.js'); const r=getCommandPolicy('milestone_status').reason; if(!/Authority/.test(r)) throw new Error('milestone_status reason missing Authority: '+r); console.log('OK milestone_status discloses Authority');" — exits 0 and prints OK, proving the milestone_status reason now contains the Authority disclaimer.

Assert uniformity across both read-only milestone commands: node -e "const {getCommandPolicy}=require('./packages/main/dist/core/command-policy.js'); for(const c of ['milestone_status','milestone_closeout']){const r=getCommandPolicy(c).reason; if(!/Authority/.test(r)) throw new Error(c+' reason omits Authority');} console.log('both disclaim Authority');" — exits 0, confirming milestone_status now matches milestone_closeout's Authority-silence wording.

edge.desc: Confirm the change is reason-only and non-behavioral: node -e "const {getCommandPolicy}=require('./packages/main/dist/core/command-policy.js'); const p=getCommandPolicy('milestone_status'); if(p.status!=='supported'||p.ownershipClass!=='readOnly'||p.destructiveRisk!=='none'||p.allowedPhases!=='all') throw new Error('milestone_status policy fields drifted: '+JSON.stringify(p)); console.log('policy fields unchanged');" — exits 0, proving only the reason string changed and status/ownershipClass/destructiveRisk/allowedPhases are untouched.

Regression: run the existing milestone-status suite (npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs) and confirm it still exits 0, verifying the reason-string edit did not break the milestone_status/milestone_closeout report builders or renderers.

items.title: Add negative-control test: empty / all-not_applicable confirmed ledger is not treated as vacuously complete
items.context: core/proofstory.ts uncovered-required-milestone loop (~L1357-1364) iterates only ledger.milestones; a confirmed ledger with an empty or all-not_applicable milestone set yields zero uncovered rows. Add a test proving a confirmed-but-vacuous ledger does NOT satisfy the milestone DONE requirement. Closes findings M5 test-gap #2 and M4 caveat.
items.userSees: Running the milestone DONE-equivalence suite (`npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs`) prints a new passing assertion block such as `ok - negative control: confirmed empty ledger is NOT vacuously milestone-complete` and `ok - negative control: confirmed all-not_applicable ledger is NOT vacuously milestone-complete`. Concretely, when `evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence` is called in `enforce` mode with a `state: 'confirmed'` ledger whose `milestones` array is empty (and again with a ledger whose every row is `status: 'not_applicable'`), on the strict-milestone path (forced by a structural multi-deliverable story signal / slicePlan), the returned report has `status: 'fail'` and `blocking: true`, and `report.gaps` contains a gap whose `code` flags the vacuous/empty required-milestone set (e.g. `vacuous_milestone_ledger` / `uncovered_required_milestones`) with severity `fail` — instead of the pre-fix behavior where `uncoveredRequiredMilestoneIds` is `[]` and the report silently returns `status: 'pass'`. An operator who reaches DONE with such a ledger sees the DONE gate refuse to close the story, citing that a confirmed milestone ledger with no applicable required milestones does not satisfy strict intent equivalence.

happy.desc: In packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs, import evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence from dist/core/proofstory.js and call it in 'enforce' mode with a story whose text carries a structural multi-deliverable signal (e.g. 'all milestones') plus a confirmed ledger built via ledger([]) (empty milestones). Assert the returned report has status==='fail', blocking===true, and report.gaps contains at least one gap with severity 'fail' referencing milestone-ledger.json whose code marks the required-milestone set as empty/vacuous. Verified by: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs exits 0 with the new assertions passing.

Second negative-control case in the same test: call evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence('enforce') with a confirmed ledger of one or more rows where every row has status 'not_applicable' (via milestone({status:'not_applicable'})).
